name: Spicy Turkey Meatballs with Lime Yogurt & Green Bean Veggie Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat two large baking dishes with a thin layer of oil.

Place turkey, bread crumbs, hot sauce, oil, and spices in a large bowl. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into mini rounded meatballs. Divide between the baking dishes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
1 cup panko bread crumbs
⅓ cup hot sauce
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place meatballs in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden and cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ red bell peppers
0.68 kg green beans
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, drain and roughly chop water chestnuts. Add to the bowl along with corn.
instructions.secondary_message:
425 g water chestnuts
3 cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; sauté until tender and starting to brown, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 tbsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice limes into the reserved bowl. Add yogurt, water, garlic powder, and salt, then stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp water
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide meatballs and veggies between plates or bowls. Drizzle meatballs with sauce and enjoy!
